exposure: extended labor for at least 1 additional hour
cohort: 78 nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies at 36 0/7 to 41 6/7 weeks gestation who reached the ACOG definition of prolonged second stage of labor
finding: Extending the length of labor in nulliparous women with prolonged second stage significantly reduced the incidence of cesarean delivery compared to usual labor guidelines.
mod_finding: Extending the length of labor in nulliparous women with prolonged second stage decreased the incidence of cesarean delivery compared with usual guidelines.
